sections.heading: SAP — SAP SE
sections.markdown:
**RE-STAMPED DISCARD (2026-10-30 IDEATION, 21d).** SAP re-screens **#4 GLOBAL MOMENTUM at $234.07 — 9.0% ABOVE the $214.78 kill** — and the judge-kill cooldown (`the fund rules` 30d, V4) runs to ~2026-11-11, so no re-advance is available even if the price were right. Retained rather than aged out only to record that a screen leader is a standing cooldown name.

**Regime vs macro frontmatter:** NEUTRAL. No desk tilt covers DM/EU software — the tilts are ID/EM (nickel FAVOR; oil-import + INDO rate-sensitive AVOID). The BoP-pressure/CAUTIOUS backdrop is a mild FX headwind for a EUR-earner, offset by beta 0.76 and ~85% recurring/cloud revenue.

**Screen signal / why now:** SAP enters the GLOBAL MOMENTUM screen at #8 (first appearance) on mom6 +31.4% after a −22.3% 12m drawdown, −23.0% off the 52w high. A quality compounder de-rated ~25% (mcap $238.6B, −25.4% y/y) while EPS grew +20.2%: multiple compression, not decay. Dated catalyst: Q3 print 2026-10-21.

**Archetype:** `derated_compounder_rerating` (rate 0.40, +50/−30, 3y). Method card: VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY.

**Deep-dive must answer:**
1. Structural or cyclical de-rating — is the −25% the AI/agentic-disruption fear eating the ERP moat (the named trap), or FX/cloud-transition optics with the moat intact?
2. Multiple-survival: at 23.8× forward / 26.8× trailing on +20% EPS, does cloud backlog + Business-AI monetization defend ≥24×, or is 23.8× a premium for a ~6% grower?
3. What must the Oct-21 print show (backlog, AI attach, margin) to re-rate — and what would falsify it?

**Fast-disqualify:**
- EV positive at base rate? YES (thin) — 0.40×50 − 0.60×30 = **+2.0%**.
- Valuation-anchored target clears entry by the base up-leg? PLAUSIBLE — consensus $257.3 (+21%); the +50%/2.5y leg needs the de-rating to reverse. Never price-anchored.
- Primary sources reachable? YES — 20-F/quarterlies, Oct-21 results; stockanalysis.com 2026-10-09.

**Not ADVANCE:** mega-cap, heavy coverage, thin EV, CAUTIOUS backdrop — a WATCH scout, not a chase.

**PROMOTED 2026-10-10 (WEEKLY_DEEP)** — consumed as a GLOBAL deep-dive; advanced to construction chain T-GLOBAL-SAP-001. Reason: dated catalyst (Q3 print 2026-10-21) + de-rated quality compounder; the chain must test structural-vs-cyclical de-rating and the 23.8x multiple.

**DISCARDED 2026-10-12 (consumed).** T-GLOBAL-SAP-001 judged KILL 2026-10-10 (no variant perception — the Bear/Revision loop stripped the structural-vs-cyclical de-rating claim). Judge-kill cooldown (30d, `the fund rules` V4 — the 60d figure earlier in this card was the pre-V4 value) runs from the 2026-10-12 kill_ledger entry → ~2026-11-11. Downgraded PROMOTED→DISCARD per the consumed convention.
